name: Five Rounds Rapid
author: DisforDemise
bootlegger: A player with the Psychopath or Slayer ability may use their ability by publicly claiming either role, or simply claiming to use "my ability".
Whenever any player is executed, the Storyteller might call for a game of Roshambo. Roshambo choices are conducted in secret, after which the Storyteller announces if the executed player dies.

If the Alchemist has the Baron ability, up to 2 Outsiders added this way may replace Minions instead of townsfolk. If they do, those Outsiders are evil, and register as Minions for Demon and Minion info.
An evil player with the Drunk ability thinks they are an evil Minion.
A player with the Drunk ability cannot think they are an in-play role token, except for the Slayer, Alchemist, or Psychopath (if evil).
